name: create_task
description: Create a background task and immediately return its ID. Include goal, context, constraints and deliverables in text. resource shared serializes tasks using shared resources. Interpret the applicable AGENTS.md routing rules semantically using eligible configured Profiles. Explicit current-task choices take precedence; otherwise leave unmatched work on existing defaults. Never silently substitute an unavailable preferred executor. Each task is a new execution. To retry finished work, create a new task. Tasks use the selected machine's Host or shared development Sandbox according to its current policy at dispatch. Task completion closes its own processes and sessions; installed tools and files remain. Shared environment changes affect other tasks.

profile.description: Eligible, user-allow-listed Profile ID selected for this task; omitted retains default routing. Use a real configured connection/model, not a provider name.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

selection_reason.description: Concise creation-time reason for the chosen executor; do not claim certainty for ambiguous work.

skills.description: Global skill names to include in this task. Omitted or empty loads no global skills. Project skills are always discovered independently.

machine_id.description: Target machine ID. Omitted follows the current machine routing. Execution uses the machine policy at dispatch; no Sandbox selection is needed.

name: list_tasks
description: Search task metadata by state and title/ID. Defaults to active tasks, 10 per page; archived tasks keep complete/cancelled status. Use attention for failed/interrupted, archived to find past results, all only with a relevant query. Follow next_offset only when needed; no polling.

phase.description: Exact execution status; overrides scope when provided

q.description: Case-insensitive title or task ID substring

name: get_task
description: Read recent results and execution state of a task.

name: guide_task
description: Queue a follow-up instruction in an existing task. Applied after the current turn; does not interrupt it. Only active tasks accept guidance. For finished or failed tasks, create a new task.

name: send_message
description: Send reference information from Main to a pot-agent task. Delivered at a safe model boundary if running, or retained as reference history if the task has ended. Does not create a work turn, interrupt current work, resume stopped tasks or authorize new permissions. Sender identity is trusted Runtime metadata, not caller supplied.

name: wait_task
description: Wait for any of up to eight tasks to complete, fail, become interrupted, cancelled or allowance-waiting. Bounded wait; no busy polling. Returns metadata, per-task cursors and timed_out. Pass returned cursors as after to suppress unchanged settled states. Does not retrieve transcripts, resume tasks or wait for exec; use wait for JavaScript runs.

name: interrupt
description: Interrupt current work while retaining task/session/files and pending guidance. Does not replay interrupted input or automatically resume. Running work retains capacity until cleanup is confirmed; run again by creating a new task. Completed task results remain complete.

name: cancel_task
description: Abandon a task: stop current execution, discard pending guidance and mark cancelled after confirmed cleanup. Retains history and files; cancelled tasks appear in Archived. Use interrupt to preserve guidance for later continuation. Completed results remain complete.

name: list_schedules
description: List scheduled plans (metadata only). Filter enabled/paused/all; use pagination.

name: get_schedule
description: Read a schedule definition and paginated execution history.

name: manage_schedule
description: Create/update/pause/resume/delete/run a persistent schedule. Pausing/deleting prevents future triggers and does not cancel current work. An immediate run is non-overlapping. All times use the specified IANA timezone. Control triggers a new task on the saved machine; each dispatch reads that machine's current execution policy. Omit machine_id on update to preserve the selected machine. Creation/update requires spec. Deletion is soft and keeps execution history.

profile.description: Optional user-allow-listed profile hint; omitted uses the worker default.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

machine_id.description: Machine to run on. Each occurrence reads its current execution policy and creates a fresh Task. Omit on update to retain the machine.

name: list_execution_targets
description: Inspect authorized Host and Sandbox execution targets grouped by Runtime; does not start a Sandbox.

name: list_assistants
description: List addressable assistants in this Control and Spaces connected through the App relay. A listed remote assistant may be offline. Does not start work.

name: send_assistant_message
description: Send a durable message to another assistant and wake its separate message conversation. Returns acceptance, not completion. Cross-Space delivery waits for App relay connectivity. Use for coordination and replies; no task migration or permissions are implied. Replies to the current correspondent automatically retain the conversation; reply_to can explicitly reference a received message. Automatic exchanges are bounded; do not send unnecessary acknowledgements.
